device.description: 12-bit 40 kSPS 4-channel sampling ADC with internal reference, byte-wide parallel and serial outputs
device.note: ads7824.pdf (SBAS044) p.2 specifications (conversion time, VIH, binary two's complement), p.3 VS 4.75-5.25 V, p.4 pin assignments and pin configuration, p.8 Tables Ia/Ib (read control), p.9 Figures 2-3 parallel timing, p.12 parallel output and Table II timing, p.13 Table III conversion control, p.14 multiplexer Tables IVa/IVb

commands.name: Convert (CS and R/C low)
commands.note: p.13 Table III (CONTC low): R/C falling with CS low, or CS falling with R/C low, starts a conversion; convert commands are ignored while BUSY is low

pages: p.2 (conversion time 20 us, VIH 2.4 V to VS+0.3 V, binary two's complement), p.3 (VS1 = VS2 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 (pin assignments: BYTE low = D11..D4, high = D3..D0 on D7-D4 with D3-D0 low; pin configuration), p.8 (Table Ia), p.9 (Figures 2-3), p.12 (parallel output text, Table II: t4/t7 21 us max, t9 83 ns, t12 83 ns), p.13 (Table III), p.14 (Tables IVa/IVb)
notModeled: analog inputs (+/-10 V), 4-channel multiplexer, internal reference (REF) and CAP buffer; every channel gives the same 0 V code
channel selection: A1/A0 (inputs with CONTC low) are latched when conversion n starts and select the channel of conversion n+1 (Table IVb); not read, the result does not depend on it

continuous conversion mode (CONTC high: conversions cycle through AIN0-AIN3 while CS, R/C and PWRD are low, A1/A0 become outputs of the next channel, Table IVa / Figure 7): CONTC is not read and A1/A0 are never driven
serial output (PAR/SER low: D4 = EXT/INT, D3 = SYNC, D2 = DATACLK, D1 = SDATA, D0 = TAG): only the parallel port (PAR/SER high) is modeled; the serial functions of D4-D0 are not

the conversion starts when the CS/R/C low period ends (write access end) rather than at its falling edge; the 40 ns - 12 us convert pulse and the rule that CS or R/C must be high before BUSY rises are not checked
reading during a conversion returns the previous result (valid up to 12 us after the start); power-up contents of the output register are indeterminate (model: the 0 V code)
PWRD (powers the analog section down, resets the multiplexer address to channel 0) is not read
variants: ADS7824UB is the higher grade (not in the skeleton). ADS7825 is the 16-bit sibling with its own datasheet.
